Text: You're in a cold sweat. In a few months, you will have to give a speech to the entire court. Nothing special - just an award ceremony for nobles for "public service" - but the thought of all those eyes on you is terrifying.
I am going to look like a fool

When you finally take the stage for your speech, you've uttered the words a hundred times at least.  The less said about your delivery the better, but at least the award ceremony passes without incident

The speech at the awards ceremony is as bad as your nightmares.  You stumble from one point to another haphazardly, hardly managing to breath.

You find yourself lost in an abandoned part of the colony.  An attempt had been made to dig deeper into the rock to gain more space, but the area is unstable and now used largely as a dumping ground.

Suddenly you see a shadow dart past, and a clatter of metal.
Dimly, you remember rumours that claim this section is haunted.

You hiss urgently into your comm pack; in moments a security squad are tearing apart the clutter.

After twenty minutes, they shake their head: nothing. You can sense their judgement like static, hanging in the bulkheads around you.

Drawing your sidearm you edge closer to a stack of debris: abandoned construction material and assorted trash. Suddenly, a cat leaps out, making a break for it.

Cats are rare in the colonies. It would be impressive if you were able to tame it.
The cat isn't very forthcoming, and not at all impressed. When you go to move closer you step a little too aggressively, and it darts further into the detritus.
Aw, there's no need to be scared
You're careful to tread lightly, act with confidence and keep your voice low. Over the next few weeks you make sure to bring it tasty morsels; after a month it trusts you enough to follow you home.
